name: bank-check
description: Check a US bank's FDIC status and estimate how much of your deposits are insured.

interface.longDescription:
Finance: check whether a US bank is FDIC insured and estimate how much of your deposits are insured, using live FDIC BankFind records.

Find a bank by name, by city and state, or by FDIC certificate number. See its legal name, certificate number, active status, primary regulator, total assets, office count and website. Read a bank's history from FDIC records: when it was established, the banks it absorbed, and whether it failed or merged and which bank took over its deposits.

Estimate deposit insurance for up to 30 accounts. Enter the FDIC certificate, the ownership category (single, joint, certain retirement, trust, business, employee benefit plan or government), the balance, the owners and, for trust accounts, the number of beneficiaries. The estimate groups deposits per bank, per owner and per ownership category, applies the 250,000 US dollar limit, splits joint accounts into equal co-owner shares, and applies the trust rule in effect since April 1, 2024 (250,000 US dollars per eligible beneficiary, up to 5 beneficiaries per owner per bank). The tool looks up each certificate in FDIC records first. Deposits at a bank that merged into another bank in the last six months (an FDIC history merger record) are estimated as that bank's own, because they stay separately insured for six months; failed, voluntarily closed, unknown and not-insured certificates, and banks that merged more than six months ago, are listed and left out. The answer shows the insured and uninsured totals first, then each bank and category, with a PDF coverage worksheet and a CSV.

Results name their source (FDIC BankFind Suite API) and the retrieval time in UTC. Coverage figures are estimates, not FDIC determinations; confirm them with the FDIC Electronic Deposit Insurance Estimator (EDIE). Employee benefit plan and government accounts are listed but not estimated. Credit unions are not covered. Generated downloads expire in about one hour.
defaultPrompt: Is Wells Fargo FDIC insured? Show its FDIC certificate number and regulator
I have $300,000 in savings and a $400,000 joint account with my spouse at FDIC cert 3511. How much is insured?
What happened to Silicon Valley Bank, FDIC cert 24735? Show its failure and merger history

positive.prompt: Is Wells Fargo FDIC insured? Show its FDIC certificate number
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Wells Fargo Bank, National Association with FDIC certificate 3511, active and FDIC insured, its regulator and total assets, the FDIC source with retrieval time, and a CSV link.

positive.prompt: What happened to Silicon Valley Bank, FDIC cert 24735?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the bank failed on 2023-03-10 with First-Citizens Bank & Trust Company as acquirer, lists its mergers and structure events, the source with retrieval time, and a CSV link.

positive.prompt: I have $300,000 in a savings account and a $400,000 joint account with my spouse, both at FDIC cert 3511. How much is FDIC insured?
positive.expected_behavior: Estimates $650,000.00 insured and $50,000.00 uninsured of $700,000.00, per category, with a PDF worksheet, a CSV and a link to FDIC EDIE.

positive.prompt: My living trust account at FDIC cert 628 holds $1,500,000 and names 7 beneficiaries. How much is insured?
positive.expected_behavior: Applies the 5-beneficiary cap: $1,250,000.00 insured and $250,000.00 uninsured, with a PDF worksheet and a CSV.

positive.prompt: Estimate FDIC coverage: trust account $600,000 with 2 beneficiaries at cert 3511, and an IRA with $260,000 at cert 628
positive.expected_behavior: Estimates $750,000.00 insured and $110,000.00 uninsured of $860,000.00 across the two banks.

negative.prompt: Is my credit union account NCUA insured?
negative.description: Do not call a tool; credit unions are insured by the NCUA, not the FDIC, and are outside these tools.

negative.prompt: Which bank pays the highest savings interest rate right now?
negative.description: Do not call a tool; the tools do not compare interest rates or recommend banks.

negative.prompt: Open a new savings account for me at Chase
negative.description: Do not call a tool; the tools only read public FDIC records and estimate coverage; they cannot open accounts.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: FDIC bank lookup, bank structure history with failures and mergers, and a deposit insurance estimate with a PDF worksheet and CSV.

de-DE.subtitle: FDIC-Bankabfrage und Deckung
de-DE.description: Pruefen Sie mit aktuellen FDIC-Daten, ob eine US-Bank FDIC-versichert ist, lesen Sie Fusionen und Insolvenzen nach und schaetzen Sie, wie viel Ihrer Einlagen je Bank, Inhaber und Kontokategorie versichert ist. Mit PDF-Arbeitsblatt und CSV. Die Werte sind Schaetzungen; bestaetigen Sie sie mit dem FDIC-Rechner EDIE.

es-ES.subtitle: Banco FDIC y cobertura
es-ES.description: Compruebe con datos actuales de la FDIC si un banco de EE. UU. esta asegurado, consulte fusiones y quiebras, y estime cuanto de sus depositos esta asegurado por banco, titular y categoria de propiedad. Incluye hoja PDF y CSV. Las cifras son estimaciones; confirmelas con la herramienta EDIE de la FDIC.

fr-FR.subtitle: Banque FDIC et couverture
fr-FR.description: Verifiez avec les donnees FDIC actuelles si une banque americaine est assuree, consultez fusions et faillites, et estimez la part assuree de vos depots par banque, titulaire et categorie de propriete. Avec fiche PDF et CSV. Les montants sont des estimations ; confirmez-les avec l'outil EDIE de la FDIC.

ja-JP.subtitle: FDIC銀行確認と保険額
ja-JP.description: 最新のFDICデータで米国の銀行がFDIC保険対象か確認し、合併や破綻の履歴を表示し、銀行・名義人・口座区分ごとに預金の保険対象額を見積もります。PDFワークシートとCSV付き。金額は見積もりです。FDICのEDIEで確認してください。

pt-BR.subtitle: Banco FDIC e cobertura
pt-BR.description: Verifique com dados atuais da FDIC se um banco dos EUA tem seguro, veja fusoes e falencias e estime quanto dos seus depositos esta segurado por banco, titular e categoria de propriedade. Com planilha PDF e CSV. Os valores sao estimativas; confirme na ferramenta EDIE da FDIC.

pl-PL.subtitle: Bank FDIC i ochrona wkladow
pl-PL.description: Sprawdz w aktualnych danych FDIC, czy bank w USA jest ubezpieczony, zobacz fuzje i upadlosci oraz oszacuj, jaka czesc depozytow jest chroniona dla kazdego banku, wlasciciela i kategorii rachunku. Z arkuszem PDF i CSV. Kwoty sa szacunkowe; potwierdz je w narzedziu EDIE FDIC.
